messages:
lee: Plan: az3 rolling NIC rebind + soft kmod reload tomorrow 13:00 UTC. Affects pools: meridian-edge and meridian-batch. 20-30m per rack, staggered. Need backfill + tenant notice.

maria: Ack. Which racks so I can prep canaries?

lee: r-az3-30..r-az3-33. Order: 30 -> 31 -> 32 -> 33. Runbook link (internal).

tom: meridian-batch has nightly training jobs; their window ends 14:15 UTC. Suggest delaying batch pool by 20m to avoid overlap.

networking: FYI interconnect maintenance at 15:00 UTC in eu-west link. Do not schedule heavy cross-region moves around that.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: az3-soft-kmod-nic - 2026-03-25T13:00:00Z. Subscribers notified.

maria: Capacity quickcheck: meridian-edge total=96 GPUs, reserved=30, headroom ~18. meridian-batch total=160 GPUs, reserved=70, headroom ~22 (after dry-run).

tom: 22 is ok but borderline. Plan: migrate low-prio batch jobs off affected racks 30m before operation. Use spare-pool-1 as backfill if needed.

lee: Ops checklist condensed: cordon+drain -> rebind NIC -> reload kmod -> pre-seed KV/model cache -> perf probe (64/128 tokens) -> uncordon. Keep 5m cooloff between racks.

maria: Commands I'll run: ```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-r-az3-30
kubectl drain gpu-node-r-az3-30 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
./tools/attach_nic --node r-az3-30 --rebind
./tools/kmod_reload --node r-az3-30 --soft
./tools/prime_kv_cache --pool meridian-edge --seq 64
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-r-az3-30```

lee: @oncall-bot set escalation: page if error-rate + latency spike >3% sustained 10m. Also enable temp rate-limiter on public endpoints for az3 during window.

oncall-bot: Escalation rule set.

tom: I'll ping tenants (batch contacts) to avoid kicking off big jobs 12:45-14:30.

lee: Final: meridian-edge start 13:00, meridian-batch start 13:40 (delayed), spare-pool-1 as backfill, temp-burst if headroom drops. Post objections now or I'll lock schedule in 15m. :thumbsup:
